trystero-nostr.js is Trystero 0.26.0 (https://github.com/dmotz/trystero) by Dan Motzenbecker,
bundled into one file so the game needs no build step. MIT licence. It includes
@noble/secp256k1 by Paul Miller, also MIT.

It handles matchmaking for player-hosted tables: browsers find each other through
public Nostr relays and then talk directly over WebRTC.
